text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Arima Kinen. After
their heated
battle last year, all eyes are
on Хиши Амадзон and
Нарита Брайан for
their big rematch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон is all fired up for her fated

one-on-one. Sparks fly as they rev up for
the
race, and now, the decisive battle is
about to
begin!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
